sql_reading_A.note: ranked by number of fall-offering catalog rows
sql_reading_A.sql: SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 1 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) DESC LIMIT 10
